.. change::
    :tags: bug, orm, unitofwork
    :tickets: 9348

    Fixed removal of a pending delete-orphan object so that pending descendants
    connected through their own ``delete-orphan`` cascades are also removed
    from the :class:`_orm.Session`.  The cleanup no longer requires users to
    add the broader ``expunge`` cascade merely to prevent those descendants
    from being inserted during the next flush.
